notes.time.pause: HS2Next-only (vanilla has no scene pause; Space is free in vanilla Studio). Blocked while a text field has focus, as every letter key.
notes.camera.lookThrough: HS2Next-only (vanilla: right-click a camera's tree row). Keypad 0 is free in vanilla Studio; again = back to the free camera (v0.3 trial 2).
notes.capture.screenshot: Vanilla F11 (Studio.GameScreenShot): inert while a text field has focus or a dialog is open; Shift+F11 opens the screenshot dialog (HS2Next-only).
notes.edit.undo: Vanilla Z (no Ctrl) undoes and Shift+Z redoes (spec 2.12); Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z added in both presets (4.5). Exact modifier matching (4.16 rule 5): vanilla also undid on Ctrl+Z through ignored modifiers.
notes.edit.redo: K1: vanilla redoes on Shift+Z and also on Ctrl+Shift+Z (Shift checked before Z, Ctrl ignored); Ctrl+Y is HS2Next-only (vanilla: nothing).
notes.edit.deselect: U18 kept: Esc never quits. Vanilla Esc opens the quit dialog (K1).
notes.edit.moveToPivot: C only (exact matching). Vanilla also fires on Ctrl+C and records an undo entry even when nothing moves (K1b).
notes.tree.prev: Tree scope: only while the workspace tree has keyboard focus; otherwise the arrows reach camera.move* (vanilla has no tree keyboard navigation and the arrows always move the camera, K1).
notes.camera.frame: hs2studio: pivot to the primary, distance kept (vanilla F).
notes.camera.moveForward: Keys (K3): 1 unit/s along camera right / forward (pitch included) / world up; dolly 1 unit/s; keypad orbit 10 deg/s x rotation speed; roll 10 deg/s; FOV 15 deg/s within [1, 60]. Mouse (K2, constant-speed mode U16): orbit 0.05 deg per raw mouse count x speeds; dolly / Y / pan 0.025 units per count x cameraSpeed; wheel none (K4).
notes.camera.fovDown: Bound to the physical keys of vanilla on the JIS keyboard (K5: HS2 / Unity 2018 read the ';' (re) key, scan 0x27, as Equals = FOV-). Chords are legacy Input KeyCodes in Unity 6 (S8): that key is Semicolon there (UI Toolkit says Equals; KeyNames.FromUiToolkit maps it). On a US keyboard this is the ';' key, not vanilla-US '='.
notes.camera.fovUp: JIS ']' (mu) key, scan 0x2B: legacy KeyCode Backslash in Unity 6 (S8; UI Toolkit RightBracket; vanilla HS2 RightBracket = FOV+, K5).
notes.camera.fovReset: JIS ':' (ke) key, scan 0x28: legacy KeyCode Quote in Unity 6 (S8; UI Toolkit Semicolon; vanilla Semicolon = FOV reset, K5).
notes.camera.rollPlus: JIS '.' (ru) key, scan 0x34: Period in both sources (S8, K5).
notes.camera.rollReset: JIS '/' (me) key, scan 0x35: Slash in both sources (S8, K5).
notes.camera.rollMinus: JIS yen key (scan 0x7D) and '\ ro' key (0x73): vanilla Backslash = roll- (K5); Unity 6 legacy Input cannot see them, UI Toolkit reports Backslash for both (S8) = the pseudo key JisBackslash (held polling from UI Toolkit KeyDown / KeyUp).
notes.camera.orbitUp: Keypad keys need a numeric keypad; the default preset has Alt+arrows.
notes.file.save: hs2studio: an untitled scene saves straight to the timestamped name (U4 / U17).
notes.help.keys: Vanilla F2 (the shortcut sheet); F1 added (free in HS2Next).
notes.tool.move: Vanilla axis drag (K6, the U6 alternative): 0.005 units per screen pixel x manipuleteSpeed, zoom-independent; the first ~4 px are swallowed by the drag threshold.
notes.click.parent: Modifier actions held while clicking a tree row or an object (spec 2.3, 4.6.2); they ignore text focus as in vanilla.
notes.gizmo.snapHold: V held during an axis drag (K6): steps 0.01 / 0.1 / 1 (option snap 0 / 1 / 2 = gizmo.hs2SnapStep) at most every 50 ms while the cursor moves (~15 steps/s measured), in the drag's sign, with absolute rounding.
notes.gizmo.resize: B + right drag changes the gizmo size (vanilla).
